id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the update entity.

*See also: [Update Core](https://esphome.io/components/update#updatecheck-action)*

check.docs: This action allows you to trigger the update entity to check for, but not install, updates.

force_update.docs:
**boolean**: Perform the update even if the device is already running the same version. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Update Core](https://esphome.io/components/update#updateperform-action)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the update entity.

*See also: [Update Core](https://esphome.io/components/update#updateperform-action)*

perform.docs: This action allows you to trigger the update entity to start the update process.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the update entity.

*See also: [Update Core](https://esphome.io/components/update#updateis_available-condition)*

is_available.docs: This condition checks if an update is available for the device.

device_class.docs:
**string**: The device class for the update entity. See [https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/binary_sensor/#device-class](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/binary_sensor/#device-class) for a list of available options.

*See also: [Update Core](https://esphome.io/components/update#configuration-variables)*

entity_category.docs:
**string**: The category of the update entity. See [https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties) for a list of available options.

*See also: [Update Core](https://esphome.io/components/update#configuration-variables)*

on_update_available.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: An automation to perform when an update is available.

*See also: [Update Core](https://esphome.io/components/update#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

*See also: [Update Core](https://esphome.io/components/update#configuration-variables)*

name.docs:
**string**: The name of the update entity. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

*See also: [Update Core](https://esphome.io/components/update#configuration-variables)*

disabled_by_default.docs:
**boolean**: If true, then this entity should not be added to any client's frontend (usually Home Assistant) without the user manually enabling it (via the Home Assistant UI). Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Update Core](https://esphome.io/components/update#configuration-variables)*

icon.docs:
**icon**: The icon to use for the update entity in the frontend.

*See also: [Update Core](https://esphome.io/components/update#configuration-variables)*
